title: Pure Stealth Kragen
summary: The Stealth Kragen strategy is a Rank 4 WATER Xyz control, burn, and Attribute-lock deck built around Number 4: Stealth Kragen and its Extra Deck offspring Stealth Kragen Spawn! While Number 4: Stealth Kragen is face-up on the field, ALL face-up monsters on the field become WATER Attribute—turning a single flipped Gozen Match ('Each player can only control 1 Attribute of monster') into a complete summon lock that prevents your opponent from summoning any non-WATER monster from their hand, Deck, or Extra Deck! Furthermore, both Number 4: Stealth Kragen and Stealth Kragen Spawn have a Quick Effect during either Main Phase to destroy 1 WATER monster your opponent controls (which is EVERY monster they control!) and burn them for half its ATK; when Number 4 is destroyed (even by your own Torrential Tribute!), it floats into up to 2 Stealth Kragen Spawn from your Extra Deck, which in turn float right back into Number 4: Stealth Kragen from your GY!

allow.Buzzsaw Shark: Core 1-card Rank 4 WATER starter: targets 1 WATER monster you control (including itself) to Special Summon a Level 4 Fish monster with a different name (Lantern Shark or Crystal Shark) directly from your Deck—immediately assembling Rank 4 Number 4: Stealth Kragen!
allow.Lantern Shark: Level 4 WATER Fish that Special Summons another Level 3–5 WATER Fish from your hand on Normal or Special Summon to overlay into Number 4: Stealth Kragen.
allow.Beautunaful Princess: Level 1 WATER Fish starter: banishes itself when Normal or Special Summoned to Special Summon Buzzsaw Shark or Lantern Shark directly from your Deck!
allow.Abyss Shark: Level 5 WATER Fish that Special Summons itself from your hand if all monsters you control are WATER, searches a Level 3–5 Fish (Buzzsaw, Lantern, or Crystal Shark), can be treated as Level 4 for a 'Number' Xyz Summon (Number 4: Stealth Kragen!), and doubles the battle damage Number 4 inflicts this turn!
allow.Crystal Shark: Level 5 WATER Fish that Special Summons itself from your hand OR GY by targeting a WATER monster on the field (even an opponent's monster turned WATER by Number 4: Stealth Kragen!) and can be treated as Level 4 for a 'Number' Xyz Summon!
allow.Silent Angler: Level 4 WATER Fish that Special Summons itself from your hand while you control a WATER monster.
allow.Fury of Kairyu-Shin: Normal Spell that searches 'Torrential Tribute' from your Deck, and banishes itself from your GY to protect your WATER monsters (like Number 4: Stealth Kragen) from being destroyed by card effects (so your Torrential Tribute wipes ONLY your opponent's board, OR lets you choose to destroy Number 4 to split it into 2 Stealth Kragen Spawn!)!
allow.Torrential Tribute: Normal Trap (searchable by Fury of Kairyu-Shin!) that destroys all monsters on the field when a monster is summoned—and when Number 4: Stealth Kragen is destroyed, it Special Summons up to 2 Stealth Kragen Spawn from your Extra Deck and attaches WATER monsters from your GY to them!
allow.Gozen Match: Limited to 1 in TCG: Continuous Trap that restricts each player to controlling only 1 Attribute of monster—and because Number 4: Stealth Kragen turns all face-up monsters on the field into WATER Attribute, your opponent is completely locked out of summoning any non-WATER monster!
allow.One for One: Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Level 1 Beautunaful Princess from your Deck to pull Buzzsaw Shark.
allow.Number 37: Hope Woven Dragon Spider Shar: Rank 4 WATER Sea Serpent Xyz (2 Level 4 WATER monsters; 2600 ATK) that reduces an opposing battling monster's ATK by 1000 and revives another monster from your GY when destroyed.
allow.Valiant Shark Lancer: Rank 5 WATER Beast-Warrior Xyz made with Level 5 Abyss Shark + Crystal Shark that detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to destroy a monster your opponent controls.
allow.Full Armored Black Ray Lancer: Rank 4 WATER Beast-Warrior Xyz that inflicts piercing battle damage and detaches a material to protect itself from destruction.
allow.Marincess Coral Anemone: Link-2 WATER monster that revives Buzzsaw Shark or Lantern Shark from your GY.

main: Buzzsaw Shark
Core 1-card Rank 4 starter: targets a Level 4 WATER monster (including itself!) to Special Summon a Level 4 Fish from your Deck—immediately Xyz Summoning Number 4: Stealth Kragen.
Beautunaful Princess
Copies 4–6 of Buzzsaw Shark: banishes itself on Normal or Special Summon to Special Summon Buzzsaw Shark directly from your Deck!
Abyss Shark

Special Summons itself from your hand while you control a WATER monster, adds Crystal Shark, Buzzsaw Shark, or Silent Angler from your Deck to your hand, and counts as Level 4 for the Xyz Summon of Number 4: Stealth Kragen!
Lantern Shark
Special Summons a Level 4 WATER Fish from your hand on Normal or Special Summon to assemble a second Rank 4 WATER Xyz alongside Number 4: Stealth Kragen.
Crystal Shark

Special Summons itself from your hand OR GY by targeting any WATER monster on the field (including an opponent's monster turned WATER by Number 4: Stealth Kragen!) and counts as Level 4 for a Number Xyz Summon.
Silent Angler
Special Summons itself from your hand while you control a WATER monster for easy Rank 4 extension.
Fury of Kairyu-Shin
Adds 'Torrential Tribute' from your Deck to your hand, and banishes itself from your GY if your WATER monster(s) would be destroyed by card effect instead.
One for One
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Beautunaful Princess from your Deck (which summons Buzzsaw Shark -> Lantern Shark -> Number 4: Stealth Kragen without using your Normal Summon!).
Torrential Tribute

Searched by Fury of Kairyu-Shin: destroys all monsters on the field on summon, either leaving Number 4 protected via Fury of Kairyu-Shin OR destroying your 2-material Number 4: Stealth Kragen to immediately summon TWO Stealth Kragen Spawn from your Extra Deck!
Gozen Match

Limited to 1 in TCG: combined with Number 4: Stealth Kragen (which turns all face-up monsters on the field into WATER Attribute), prevents your opponent from Normal, Flip, or Special Summoning any non-WATER monster while they control a face-up monster!
